scope: Explicit hypotheses in LITERATURE_AUDIT and ROOT_REVIEW; no signed or Lean proof and no new algorithmic speed claim.
statement: Written scoped applicability arguments show that exact compositional buckets on a prime-order group are constant or injective; an even bucket with a fixed carry set over all affine noncancelling pairs has image size at most the squared carry-set size; a canonical scalar-residue oracle on all points recovers DLP digits; and the full proper-subset circulant indicator has full rational rank. In the declared conventional full-rank uniform-target model, setup B^sigma, empty-inclusive query B^tau and matrix B^2 yield the necessary exponent budget max(sigma,2)+tau<m-1 for a balanced sub-square-root total. These are scoped derivations, not universal lower bounds.
